q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of innerwear such as briefs and vests?
title: Innerwear carbon footprint per piece
short: Weigh the knitted fabric in each piece, including cutting waste, and multiply by your fabric supplier's per-kg figure. Add elastic, thread, stitching and packing, then divide the unit's electricity and fuel by pieces passed in the same period.

ul: Knitted fabric per piece, from marker efficiency and GSM.
Ask the knitting and processing unit for a per-kg figure; dyeing is usually its largest energy use.

p: Report per piece by style. A pack of three is three pieces plus one pack's packaging.

lines: Plant total: 25,560 / 400,000 = 0.0639 kg CO2 per piece

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
